name: suede
description: Suede AI open-source skills for SEO, marketing, and business operations in Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: suede-skills
plugins.description: Suede AI open-source skills for SEO, marketing, and business operations in Claude Code and Codex. Installs the complete pack, including code review, app delivery, and creator workflows.

plugins.name: suede-agent-workflows
plugins.description: Suede AI multi-agent orchestration subset: search competing plans and ship one selected repo change through the Suede Thought Graph DAG (suede-graph-flo-xr), coordinate build lanes with quality gates and a signed handoff (suede-agent-teams), route cross-surface work end to end (suede-workflow-skills), and turn AI features into eval specs and acceptance gates (suede-ai-eval).

plugins.name: suede-code
plugins.description: Suede AI code quality subset: one-pass review and A-F ship verdict with TypeScript, React, Next.js, OWASP, and database checklists, plus findings-only and grade-only modes (suede-code), and CI branch protection that gates the merge (suede-ci-gate).

plugins.name: suede-marketing
plugins.description: Suede AI marketing and growth subset: SEO and AI search, paid acquisition and outbound, monetization (pricing, offers, paywalls), lifecycle and retention, and the measurement and operations layer. License notices for adapted material are in NOTICE.md.
